story.title: The Story of Ngon-Lam: From Saphan Lueang to Chula Soi 9
story.meaningText: The name "Ngon-Lam" (Ngon Lắm) translates directly from Vietnamese to mean "Very Delicious" — the founding culinary commitment behind every dish we prepare.
story.originsTitle: The Saphan Lueang Origins (Nearly 26 Years Ago)
story.originsText: Long before anchoring itself near Chulalongkorn University, the restaurant originally opened its doors nearly 26 years ago along Rama IV Road in the vibrant Saphan Lueang neighborhood. In its early years, it became a beloved neighborhood staple known for traditional flavors and walls proudly decorated with old-school reviews, news clippings, and guest photos.
story.expansionTitle: The Expansion & Relocation to Chula Soi 9
story.expansionText: As its popularity grew, the brand experimented with upscale branch locations in shopping hubs like Siam and Silom. Eventually, the main operations relocated slightly down Rama IV Road to the commercial townhouse space right at the front of Chula Soi 9 (Sam Yan), where it continues to welcome generations of families, students, and local foodies.
story.preservingTitle: Preserving the Recipe & Secret Dipping Sauce
story.preservingText: Despite moving, the restaurant's legacy rests on its commitment to unaltered, authentic cooking methods and its legendary, closely guarded dipping sauce formulas. It remains celebrated for its authentic flavors and generous serving of fresh traditional herbs and vegetables to accompany its classic platters.
